dom.title: Photosynthesis and respiration
dom.bodyText:
science

Photosynthesis and respiration
All sections
1
Photosynthesis and respiration

PART 1 OF 1

Photosynthesis and respiration
Photosynthesis

Inputs: carbon dioxide, water, and light energy. Outputs: glucose and oxygen. Role: stores light energy in glucose.

Cellular respiration

Inputs: glucose and oxygen. Outputs: carbon dioxide, water, and released energy. Role: releases the energy stored in glucose so the cell can use it.

KEY IDEA

Photosynthesis stores energy in glucose, and cellular respiration releases that energy, so the two pathways feed each other's inputs and outputs.
